# throuly

> Real estate transactions reimagined — affordability tools, property search, and agent collaboration in one private, privacy-first platform serving all 50 US states.

throuly helps buyers, sellers, and agents navigate the real estate process end to end: calculating affordability, comparing loan options, analyzing properties, finding qualifying assistance programs, and managing deals through a transparent pipeline.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of throuly's Scout (buyers), List (sellers), and Compass (agents) journeys.
- [Buyers](/buyers): Step-by-step home affordability calculator across all 50 states with DTI-based loan options.
- [Assistance Programs](/buyers/programs): AI-generated down-payment assistance and first-time buyer grants.
- [Sellers](/sellers): Seller planning tools, repair estimates, mortgage payoff, and FSBO vs agent comparison.
- [Scout](/scout): Buyer product overview — search, match, and underwrite properties privately.
- [Compass](/compass): Agent product overview — CRM, pipeline, offers, and client collaboration.
- [List](/list): Seller product overview — listing prep, exposure, and offer management.
- [Analyzer](/analyzer): AI-powered address and property analysis with market intelligence.
- [Property Search](/properties/search): Search active listings across the platform.
- [Resources](/resources): Educational articles, calculators, and market guides.
- [Connect Agents](/connect/agents): Directory of verified real estate agents by state.
- [Connect Lenders](/connect/lenders): Directory of verified lenders by state.
- [Try it Free](/try-it-free): Free access to core throuly tools.

## Guides

- [Buyers Guide](/guides/buyers): How to prepare, qualify, and close as a homebuyer.
- [Sellers Guide](/guides/sellers): How to price, prepare, and market a home for sale.
- [Investors Guide](/guides/investors): Rental yield, NOI, cap rate, and cash-on-cash analysis.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Account access for buyers, sellers, and agents.
